verdict.rationale: skills.sh ships as a documented CLI (`npx skills ...`) with rich, well-documented flags for non-interactive/CI use and even agent auto-detection that lets coding agents drive it programmatically without prompts (skills-cli-probe-rt-1, skills-cli-gh-8/31). However there is no documented REST or SDK-style public API — a community member explicitly asked 'Please make a rest API!' implying none exists (skills-cli-comm-5) — so agentic access is limited to shell/CLI invocation rather than a first-class API contract. Missing for 10: a formal REST/SDK API surface, API reference docs, and independent confirmation of programmatic (non-CLI) access.
